segments.name: Hook
segments.narration: Three in the afternoon, in Pune. Outside these hospitals and schools, people wait on footpaths in full sun. Cities have money for trees and shade, but no quick way to decide where it helps most.

lowerThird.text: Priority map · footpath shade at 1, 3 and 4 pm

segments.narration: EcoZone AI maps where heat, missing afternoon shade and waiting people overlap. Shade comes from building geometry at one, three and four pm. Across Deccan Gymkhana, footpath shade is just {{area.pss}} out of 100.

segments.name: Close: trust and limits
segments.narration: Every number here comes from one deterministic engine. Gemini proposes and explains, but never computes a score. We report what we measured: over four budgets, live Gemini beat the greedy baseline once and lost three times. Our heat index agrees only weakly with Landsat surface temperature on held-out blocks, and that is not significant. EcoZone AI: repair and protect a city's cooling network.
